name: J. J.
source:
Hobbies: Moddinging firearms
Likes: The smell of gunfire
Dislikes: Sweet perfume

A man who runs a shop called "SEXDEAMON" located on Chuo street in Chisakura town. 
This job is a cover up for his real identity, he actually belongs to the Hunter Association and supports [url=/c12954]Yuuka[/url] from the shadows.

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/mdb-dvd2/cha/mdbdvd_cha17.htm]official website[/url].]
